items.name: nocobase-ai
items.title: NocoBase AI Employee UI
items.description: Application-owned AI employee chat components, providers, transports, frontend tools, page context, form integration, and rich tool renderers.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee and its authenticated /api/ai routes. Import the installed library through index.ts and compose NocoBaseAIRootProvider, AIChatProvider, and a chat surface. The source is application-owned; review upgrades with a three-way merge instead of overwriting local edits.
